HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: most-likely-path inference in a hidden Markov model (Viterbi)

value.built_to: recover the most-likely sequence of hidden states that produced an observed sequence, by dynamic programming over the HMM trellis (predict-then-max at each step)
value.pressure: the true state sequence is never observed, only noisy emissions; the number of possible paths is exponential in sequence length
value.success_means: the decoded path matches the true generating states on the test HMM; likelihood computed correctly

value.pressure: hidden state, noisy/ambiguous emissions, exponential path space
value.failure_condition: a wrong transition/emission model yields a wrong decoded path -- a speech recogniser or gene finder built on it makes systematic errors

cut.note: two organs and a table: a shift-register encoder whose outputs are precomputed per (state, input), and a decoder that keeps one survivor per state by add-compare-select and walks back the survivor pointers

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.mechanism: state = the last constraint-1 input bits; NextState shifts the new bit in; each parity bit is the XOR of the state-plus-input bits selected by a generator polynomial (ReverseBits handles the bit order); the 2^constraint outputs are tabulated once; Encode walks the bits and appends constraint-1 zero bits to flush the register to state 0
organs.input: a bit string; constraint length; polynomials
assumptions: the decoder knows the same polynomials; the tail flush returns to state 0 so the decoder can end anywhere but the encoder ends known
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the table makes both encoding and branch metrics a lookup

organs.mechanism: per received symbol, for each of 2^(constraint-1) states take the two predecessor states, add the Hamming distance between the received bits and the tabulated output of that transition to each predecessor's path metric, keep the smaller (ties to the 0-branch) and record the chosen predecessor in a trellis column; unreachable states carry INT_MAX and are never extended; at the end start from the minimum-metric state and walk the trellis backward, emitting the input bit implied by each state, then reverse and drop the constraint-1 tail bits
organs.input: the received bit string (padded with zeros to a symbol multiple)
organs.state: 2^(constraint-1) path metrics; a trellis of predecessor indices, one column per symbol
assumptions: hard decisions (Hamming distance), so soft channel information is discarded; memory grows linearly with the message (no sliding-window traceback)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: maximum-likelihood decoding of a convolutional code in O(states x length) instead of O(2^length)
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: a burst longer than the constraint length defeats it (no interleaver here); the min_element tie-break at the end favours the lowest state
organs.human_prior: Viterbi 1967; the add-compare-select formulation and the tie-to-zero convention are the implementer's
organs.source_boundary: the four functions and the Trellis typedef

pressures.condition: a finite-state machine emits redundant symbols from an input sequence; some symbols are flipped; the receiver holds the machine's description and must return the input
pressures.resource_or_constraint: memory per state and per symbol; a decision per symbol
pressures.world_punishes: decoders that decide per symbol (no memory) and decoders that enumerate paths (no budget)
pressures.observable_consequence: bit error rate vs flip probability, against the per-symbol decision baseline
pressures.vacuity_condition: no flips, or a code with one state
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world that reveals the input
pressures.cheat_control: a decoder handed the true input must show zero errors; the per-symbol (memoryless) baseline must show errors at any positive flip rate: the world must separate them or the redundancy pressure is absent
